scope: Read-only CLI, native AWS console inspection and official AWS documentation. No plan upgrade, payment submission, identity upload, support case or AWS resource deployment was performed.
providerMessage: The AWS Access Key Id needs a subscription for the service

conclusion.confirmed: Sign-in works and Account Management reports an ACTIVE account, but the Free plan has not started and the required deployment/messaging services reject access for missing service subscription.
conclusion.notDetermined: Missing payment method observed. Whether completing payment verification alone will remove the service subscription failures has not yet been established.
conclusion.paidPlanRequired: Not established by these errors. Official documentation lists CloudFormation, Lambda, DynamoDB and SES among services available in its new Free signup experience, subject to experience-specific restrictions.
conclusion.activationApi: No documented standalone account-activation API was found in the Account Management operations. UpgradeAccountPlan accepts FREE or PAID in its schema, but documentation does not establish that setting FREE activates a NOT_STARTED plan. It was not called.
conclusion.nextReadOnlyUIInspection: Completed: identity verification is already Verified, while Payment preferences reports zero payment methods. The owner must complete payment verification; its effect on service access must then be checked.
conclusion.timing: The account was created six days before this check. A new verification submission can still take time; account creation age alone does not identify the outstanding step.

freePlanConstraint.apnWarning: AWS documents that joining AWS Partner Network automatically upgrades Free accounts to Paid. Do not enroll this account in APN under the current constraint. Existing membership through a partner organization must be established separately and truthfully.
freePlanConstraint.advancedFeatures: Activating advanced AWS features requires a prior upgrade and is irreversible. It was not attempted.

cdkWarnings: CloudFront minimumProtocolVersion is ignored with the default CloudFront certificate; a custom certificate is required for a configurable minimum TLS policy.
